description:
Test ZFS UID/GID mapping patch

These tests are in form of shell scripts, they have been taken from the
patch which added them to the ZFS test suite.
name: zfs-ugidmap

default.script:
machine.start
machine.wait_for_service("pool-tank")

test_dir = "/ugidmap"
test_run = File.join(test_dir, "run.sh")

# Deploy tests
machine.mkdir(test_dir)

tests = %w(defaults properties send-recv mappings acl-host)
files = %w(run setup cleanup acl-ct) + tests

files.each do |name|
  machine.push_file(
    File.join("/nix/store/27j92x0czq9ydhi14pkwpkpah3v91k22-ugidmap", "#{name}.sh"),
    File.join(test_dir, "#{name}.sh"),
  )
end

machine.succeeds("chmod +x #{test_run}")

# Run tests
tests.each do |name|
  machine.succeeds("#{test_run} #{test_dir} #{name}")
end

machine.succeeds("#{test_run} #{test_dir} acl-ct prepare")
machine.wait_until_container_online('testct', timeout: 60)
container_apk(machine, 'testct', 'add', 'acl', name: 'Install ACL tools in testct')
machine.succeeds("#{test_run} #{test_dir} acl-ct run")
